short: French article before a sport or art noun (guess)
notes: Card: scattered, ' de' x4, l'é, leurs, Russian ' а', ' L', ' a'; many top examples are about sport, dance or fitness. Probes: 'L'art du' 0.93, 'ponctuée de spectacles' 0.67, 'faire du sport' 0.60, 'appelée l'art' 0.57; 'formulaires de demande' 0.18, 'Il a mangé' 0.07. But also English 'an accepted' 0.40, German ' Auf' 0.40. Low confidence: the shared pattern may be something else.
